source: stockanalysis.com, EGX quote page, condensed income statement sourced from S&P Global Market Intelligence (secondary provider, not read from the exchange filing)
source_note: The provider prints only Revenue, Gross Profit, Operating Income, Net Income and EPS for this listing, in EGP millions; those five lines are copied verbatim and multiplied by one million. Cost of Sales and Operating Expenses are arithmetic from the printed lines and are flagged derived. Profit Before Tax, Income Tax and Net Finance Costs are NOT printed by this source and are left empty rather than inferred: a prior version of this file set Profit Before Tax equal to Net Profit, which asserted a tax rate of zero that the source never reported. The provider trailing twelve month column is excluded.
